newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Fidelity instutional cash fund AAAm.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Fidelity instutional cash fund AAAm.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it assigned its AAAm rating to the Fidelity Institutional Cash Portfolios Government Fund.
"The rating will be based on Standard & Poor's analysis of the fund's credit quality, market price exposure, and management," S&P said in a statement.
"The rating signifies that safety of invested principal is good and the portfolio maintains a sound capacity to maintain a $1 per share net asset value," S&P said.

The Fidelity Institutional Cash Portfolios Government, which commenced operations on July 25, 1985, offers institutional and corporate investors a convenient and economic way to invest in a professionally managed portfolio of money market instruments, S&P said.
The fund's investment objective is to seek to obtain as high a level of current income as is consistent with the preservation of principal and liquidity, S&P said.
